challenge.en: 3D measurement from a high mounting height, stitched across a large field of view from 12 stereo camera pairs.
challenge.zh-TW: 在高安裝高度下，以 12 組立體相機拼接大視野進行 3D 量測。

solution.en: Contributed C++/Python 3D-measurement work to the team that advanced the MVP to factory-ready production testing.
solution.zh-TW: 參與 C++/Python 3D 量測開發，團隊將 MVP 推進至工廠就緒的產線測試。

boundary.en: Team project. Scope spanned system design, camera integration, boundary-condition exploration, test specifications, and analysis with hardware collaborators.
boundary.zh-TW: 團隊專案。範圍涵蓋系統設計、相機整合、邊界條件探索、測試規格，以及與硬體夥伴的分析。

aInput.en: Perspective distortion and seams from high-mounted multi-camera placement
aInput.zh-TW: 高架多相機配置造成的透視畸變與拼接接縫

weakestLink.en: Calibration and alignment across 12 stereo camera pairs
weakestLink.zh-TW: 12 組立體相機之間的標定與對齊

bOutput.en: A 3D-measurement line ready for factory production testing
bOutput.zh-TW: 可進入工廠產線測試的 3D 量測系統

strictInvariant.en: Stitched 3D measurements must agree with the physical calibration target.
strictInvariant.zh-TW: 拼接後的 3D 量測必須與實體標定靶一致。

en: Modifying conveyor mechanical assemblies on the production line
zh-TW: 改造產線輸送帶的機械結構
自研專用影像感測器硬體

failureConditions.en: If vibration or temperature moves the cameras beyond calibration tolerance, the measurement should be recalibrated, not trusted.
failureConditions.zh-TW: 若震動或溫度使相機偏離標定容差，量測結果應重新標定，而不是直接採信。

challenger.en: What made high-mounted, large-FOV measurement hard?
challenger.zh-TW: 高架、大視野量測難在哪裡？

defense.en: Perspective distortion and seams between camera views. Calibration across all 12 pairs had to hold before any stitched measurement meant anything.
defense.zh-TW: 透視畸變與相機視野之間的接縫。12 組相機的標定先要成立，拼接後的量測才有意義。

challenger.en: What was your part, and what was the team's?
challenger.zh-TW: 哪些是你做的，哪些是團隊做的？

defense.en: I contributed C++/Python measurement work within a cross-functional team; the advance from MVP to factory-ready testing was a team milestone. The exact split of individual tasks was not recorded, so I describe the project scope rather than claim sole ownership.
defense.zh-TW: 我在跨部門團隊中負責 C++/Python 量測相關工作；從 MVP 到工廠就緒測試是團隊里程碑。個人分工沒有留下紀錄，所以我描述專案範圍，不宣稱獨自負責。

staff.zh-TW: 產線規模的多相機 3D 量測

coreQuestion.en: How do 12 stereo pairs produce one trustworthy measurement?
coreQuestion.zh-TW: 12 組立體相機如何產出一個可信的量測？

breakthrough.en: Calibration, stitching, and test specifications worked together so the system could enter factory testing.
breakthrough.zh-TW: 標定、拼接與測試規格相互配合，系統得以進入工廠測試。

verifiedMoat.en: The team advanced the MVP to factory-ready production testing.
verifiedMoat.zh-TW: 團隊將 MVP 推進至工廠就緒的產線測試。

em.en: Cross-functional work between software and hardware
em.zh-TW: 軟硬體之間的跨部門協作

coreQuestion.en: How do software iteration and hardware tuning stay in step?
coreQuestion.zh-TW: 軟體迭代與硬體調校如何保持同步？

breakthrough.en: Test specifications and result analysis gave hardware collaborators something concrete to tune against.
breakthrough.zh-TW: 測試規格與結果分析讓硬體夥伴有具體的調校依據。

verifiedMoat.en: Reached the production-testing stage before product launch.
verifiedMoat.zh-TW: 在產品上市前達到產線測試階段。

recruiter.en: 3D measurement, camera calibration, and factory testing
recruiter.zh-TW: 3D 量測、相機標定與工廠測試

coreQuestion.en: What industrial computer-vision work has Blake done?
coreQuestion.zh-TW: Blake 做過哪些工業電腦視覺工作？

breakthrough.en: C++/Python 3D measurement on a 12-stereo-pair line, plus earlier AOI and RealSense metrology roles.
breakthrough.zh-TW: 12 組立體相機產線的 C++/Python 3D 量測，以及先前的 AOI 與 RealSense 量測經歷。

verifiedMoat.en: MVP to factory-ready production testing, as a team.
verifiedMoat.zh-TW: 與團隊一起把 MVP 推進至工廠就緒的產線測試。
